app.name: SamadhanSetu
app.description: A digital platform connecting citizens, universities, and industry to solve Jharkhand's societal challenges collaboratively.

hero.title: Transforming Jharkhand Through Collaborative Problem Solving
hero.subtitle: Citizens report verified grassroots challenges. Universities engineer open solutions. Industry partners sponsor pilots and deploy at scale.

howItWorks.title: How SamadhanSetu Works
howItWorks.subtitle: A structured matchmaking workflow connecting posters, solvers, and enablers
howItWorks.step1Desc: Citizens and officials report district challenges with location and urgency metadata.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Student & faculty teams pitch tailored engineering and scientific solutions.
howItWorks.step3Desc: CSR and corporate partners offer funding, equipment, and pilot deployments.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Transparent state-level tracking from initial review to permanent deployment.

citizen.title: Citizens & Administration
citizen.desc: Crowdsource real issues across 24 districts and track resolution progress transparently.

university.title: Universities & Innovation Cells
university.desc: Channel academic research, student capstone projects, and lab innovations into real community impact.

industry.title: Industry & CSR Partners
industry.desc: Direct CSR funding and technology resources into verified local interventions with audited milestones.
